title: Coefficient functions on a site object are unchanged
statement: Fix a prime l and a normalized base comparison [lem-sf-adic-module-section-data] for every scheme. There exists a family of ring-sheaf isomorphisms from the comparison ring on U to the literal restriction of the comparison ring on X, for every pro-etale site object U of X, whose component on every further object is heterogeneously equal to the identity on each coefficient function.

source.place: Sections Localization of ringed sites, Tensor product and Internal Hom; definition-localize-ringed-site, lemma-tensor-product-pullback, lemma-internal-hom-restriction and lemma-internal-hom-adjoint-tensor. Specialization and normalization steps of lem-sf-adic-module-slice-compatibility; the native constructions in lean/WeilConjectures/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Mod/Evaluation.lean and lean/WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/ProEtale/Adic/InternalHomEvaluation.lean.

proof.text: Compose the coefficient ring equivalence on the source with the inverse coefficient equivalence on the composed object. Both middle rings are locally finite functions on the identical underlying scheme. Their precomposition formulas give naturality. Form the sheaf iso objectwise and combine the two supplied coefficient_identity proofs to establish the identity normalization.

proof_origin.place: Explicit refinement of the corresponding action, pure-tensor or transpose step of lem-sf-adic-module-slice-compatibility; the Lean assembly uses the existing native and base normalization APIs.

theorem adicSliceCoefficientComparison (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (base : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, AdicModuleSectionComparison l X) :
    ∃ c : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEt),
      (base U.left).ring ≅
        (localizationRestriction RingCat.{u + 1} U.hom U.prop).obj (base X).ring,
      ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEt) (V : U.left.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (r : (base U.left).ring.obj.obj V), HEq (((c X U).hom.hom.app V) r) r
